answer: Watch how identities react to surprise rule changes. Each epoch the protocol quietly shifts one parameter, such as a fee or a deadline. Honest agents, tuned by separate operators, adapt at scattered times, like streams finding their own paths through karst. Personas run by one operator get the fix in a single config push, so their behavior delta lands in the same minute. Accounts that change in lockstep across several shifts are pooled into one reward. To hide, a farm must update each persona on its own slow, glacier-paced schedule and lose earnings while it lags.
